I'm Eric Anderson, a data scientist who works in R and Shiny. I maintain [shinyglass](https://ericrayanderson.github.io/shinyglass/), a theming package for Shiny apps.

This blog is where I write about R packages I build and things I run into while building Shiny apps. There is an [RSS feed](index.xml) for all posts.
